name: Beryllium oxide
description: Beryllium oxide (CAS 1304-56-9 ), also known as beryllia, is a high-performance ceramic material sourced for applications where exceptional thermal conductivity must be combined with electrical insulation. Thermalox is a recognized commercial grade used in precision industrial and defense components. In electronics, beryllia substrates and packages are used for high-power transistors and microwave devices. RF amplifiers utilize this material where heat dissipation is critical to component reliability. Aerospace and defense manufacturers specify these ceramics for radar systems and missile guidance components. Satellite electronics demand dimensional stability under extreme thermal cycling, making this material essential. Nuclear applications utilize beryllia as a neutron moderator and reflector material in reactor design. Specialty laser and optical systems also incorporate these components where thermal management directly affects output consistency. This ensures equipment longevity in demanding industrial environments. The material is supplied as high-purity powder, sintered ceramic shapes, and machined components to meet specific engineering tolerances. Standard grades include 99.0% and 99.5% purity powder. These powders are used for ceramic processing, as well as finished substrate forms for electronics manufacturing. Industrial buyers typically source to internal or customer-defined specifications. Given the tightly controlled performance requirements of end applications, quality control is paramount.
